'''Alan G. McHughen''' (born 13 April 1954) is a Canadian-American [[molecular biology|molecular biologist]] known for his scholarship in DNA technologies and work developing United States and Canadian regulations governing the safety of genetically engineered crops and foods.

==Early life and education==

* [[Dalhousie University]], B.Sc. Biology/Biochemistry 1976
* [[Oxford University]], D.Phil., Developmental Botany, 1979
* [[Yale University]], Postdoctoral Fellow 1979–1982

==Career and research==

McHughen served as an Assistant then full Professor and Research Scientist with the [[University of Saskatchewan]] from 1982 to 2002. He currently leads the McHughen Research Group at the [[University of California, Riverside]], in the Department of Botany and Plant Sciences.

From 2011 to 2012 McHughen served as a [[United States Department of State#Jefferson Science Fellows Program|Jefferson Science Fellow]] and Senior Policy Analyst in the [[Executive Office of the President of the United States|Executive Office of the President]] in the [[Presidency of Barack Obama|Obama administration]].<ref>[https://sites.nationalacademies.org/pga/Jefferson/PGA_061892 Alan McHughen], Jefferson Science Fellowship Program – National Academies of Science, Accessed 28 March 2022.</ref>

McHughen is a past-President of the International Society for Biosafety Research, a fellow with the [[American College of Nutrition]] (2002), a [[Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science|AAAS Fellow]] with the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]] (2010), and member of the American Society of Plant Biology.

==Awards and honors==

McHughen received the Robert Anderson Fellowship in Biochemistry from Yale University and a research fellowship from the Royal Commission for the Exhibition of 1851.<ref>[https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/517739 UC Riverside plant biotechnologist receives prestigious Jefferson Science Fellowship], University of California-Riverside, 26 August 2011.</ref> He also received the Science in Society Book of the Year Award in 2000  from the Science Writers & Communicators of Canada, the Certificate of Merit from the [[U.S. Department of Agriculture]] in 2006,  and the Distinguished Lecturer Award from the [[U.S. Environmental Protection Agency]] in 2001.<ref>[https://www.24-7pressrelease.com/press-release/456637/alan-mchughen-phd-presented-with-the-albert-nelson-marquis-lifetime-achievement-award-by-marquis-whos-who Alan McHughen, Ph.D., Presented with the Albert Nelson Marquis Lifetime Achievement Award], Marquis Who’s Who, 18 September 2018.</ref>

==Publications==

McHughen is the author of numerous peer-reviewed research articles, academic papers, and contributor to text books on the issue of [[genetically modified crop]]s.<ref>[https://mchughenlab.ucr.edu/publications Publications from the McHughen lab], UC Riverside, accessed 20 April 2022.</ref>  Significant authored books include:

*{{cite book |last=McHughen |first=Alan |author-link=Alan McHughen |date=19 May 2020 |title=DNA Demystified: Unravelling the Double Helix |url=https://oxford.universitypressscholarship.com/view/10.1093/oso/9780190092962.001.0001/oso-9780190092962|location=London|publisher=Oxford University Press |page=392 |isbn=0190092963}}
*{{cite book |last=McHughen |first=Alan |author-link=Alan McHughen |date=26 March 2002 |title=Transgenic Plants and Crops 1st Edition|url=https://www.routledge.com/Transgenic-Plants-and-Crops/Khachatourians-Hui-Scorza-Nip-Hui/p/book/9780824705459|location=Boca Raton|publisher=CRC Press |page=888|isbn=0824705459}}
*{{cite book |last=McHughen |first=Alan |author-link=Alan McHughen |date= 22 June 2000 |title=Pandora's Picnic Basket: The Potential and Hazards of Genetically Modified Foods |url=https://www.amazon.com/Pandoras-Picnic-Basket-Potential-Genetically/dp/0198506740|location=London|publisher=Oxford University Press|page=288|isbn=0198506740}}
*{{cite book |last=McHughen |first=Alan |author-link=Alan McHughen |date= 1 January 2000 |title=A Consumer's Guide to GM Food |url=https://www.abebooks.com/9780198507147/Consumers-Guide-GM-Food-McHughen-0198507143/plp|location=London|publisher=Oxford University Press|page=211|isbn=9780198507147}}
